title: OSPF Cost Asymmetry — pe1 path to pe2 suboptimal
symptom: Traffic from pe1 to pe2 loopback (10.255.1.2) taking longer path via p6 instead of direct p1/p2
root_cause: OSPF cost set to 1000 on pe1 eth1 (toward p1), forcing all traffic via eth2 then longer path
fix_command: delete protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface eth1 metric
